description: This bar chart illustrates the “effect” values for six different models—mBERT-L2, XLM-L2, mBERT-R2, XLM-R2, mBERT-B2, and XLM-B2—across seven language families. The horizontal axis represents the language family categories: IE-Baltic, IE-Germanic, IE-Indic, IE-Romance, IE-Slavic, IE-other, Isolate, Semitic, and Uralic, listed in that order. The vertical axis is labeled “effect” and displays a linear scale ranging from 0 to 30, with tick marks at intervals of 5. For each language family, there are six bars representing the effect values for each of the six models; mBERT-L2 is represented by a dark green bar, XLM-L2 by a light green bar, mBERT-R2 by a dark red bar, XLM-R2 by a light red bar, mBERT-B2 by a dark blue bar, and XLM-B2 by a light blue bar. Each bar is accompanied by a black error bar indicating the variance. The shortest bars are generally observed for the “Isolate” language family, with values around 1-3 for most models, while the tallest bars are observed for the “Semitic” language family, with values reaching approximately 28 for some models. The bars are not explicitly sorted, and no bars are visually emphasized through shading, bolding, outlining, or annotation.
